config.description: Optional. Without it the server runs in local mode: it scans your workspace with the bundled deterministic engine and returns fix guidance. Set it to also reach the repositories you connected to SPHIOR on GitHub, with their history and verifiable scan records. Create one under Settings → API at https://sphior.com/app?settings=api
